starlit.message.wish: ✦ You made a wish on a shooting star ✦
starlit.message.wish.fireball: ✦ You made a wish on a fireball! It feels extra lucky ✦
starlit.event.shower: A meteor shower lights up the sky tonight
starlit.event.storm: auroras may reach every biome tonight
starlit.options.title: Starlit
starlit.options.enabled.tooltip: Turns every Starlit sky effect on or off. Off shows the vanilla sky.
starlit.options.brightness.tooltip: How bright all Starlit effects are.
starlit.options.star_count.tooltip: How many stars fill the night sky. Vanilla keeps Minecraft's own 1,500 stars.
starlit.options.star_colors.tooltip: Gives stars real colors, from hot blue-white to cool orange-red.
starlit.options.stars_at_dusk.tooltip: The brightest stars come out earlier in the evening and stay longer at dawn.
starlit.options.constellations.tooltip: Adds hidden constellations to the sky: a Creeper, a Sword, a Pickaxe, a Heart and a Ghast. Can you find them?
starlit.options.constellation_lines.tool: Draws faint lines between the stars of each constellation.
starlit.options.star_spikes.tooltip: The brightest stars get soft four-pointed sparkles.
starlit.options.spyglass.tooltip: Looking through a spyglass brings out fainter stars, galaxies and nebulae.
starlit.options.end_sky.tooltip: Fills the sky of the End with slowly swirling violet nebulae and strange stars.
starlit.options.modded_skies.tooltip: Paints the Starlit sky over the custom skies of dimensions added by other mods.
starlit.options.wishes.tooltip: Catch a shooting star in the middle of your view to make a wish.
starlit.options.milky_way.tooltip: A glowing band of distant stars and dark dust lanes across the night sky.
starlit.options.nebulae.tooltip: Faint colored gas clouds scattered across the sky.
starlit.options.galaxies.tooltip: Distant spiral and elliptical galaxies, best seen on dark nights.
starlit.options.planets.tooltip: Three bright planets that slowly wander along the sun's path from night to night.
starlit.options.moon_glow.tooltip: A soft halo around the moon, brightest at full moon.
starlit.options.comets.tooltip: How often a comet visits. A comet stays for several nights, growing brighter and then fading.
starlit.options.shooting_stars.tooltip: How often shooting stars streak across the sky.
starlit.options.meteor_showers.tooltip: How often a night brings a meteor shower, with dozens of meteors racing out from one point of the sky.
starlit.options.fireballs.tooltip: Now and then a meteor is a big, slow, colorful fireball.
starlit.options.announce.tooltip: Tells you at dusk when a meteor shower, a comet or a strong aurora is coming.
starlit.options.aurora.tooltip: Northern lights. Cold Biomes shows them in snowy places, and on rare stormy nights everywhere.
starlit.options.aurora_colors.tooltip: The color of the northern lights.
starlit.options.aurora_brightness.toolti: How bright the northern lights are.
starlit.options.shader_mode.tooltip: What Starlit does while an Iris or Oculus shader pack is on. Replace swaps the pack's sky for Starlit's, Overlay draws Starlit's stars and effects on top of the pack's sky, Off leaves the sky to the pack.
starlit.options.atmosphere.tooltip: A deeper blue overhead, a soft haze at the horizon and a warm glow around the sun.
starlit.options.sunsets.tooltip: Fiery horizons, sunbeams, a pink afterglow and Earth's shadow rising opposite the setting sun.
starlit.options.halos.tooltip: Rings of light around the sun and moon, with bright sun dogs beside them. Common in cold biomes, rare elsewhere.
starlit.options.rainbows.tooltip: A rainbow appears opposite the sun for a while after the rain stops.
starlit.options.birds.tooltip: Flocks of birds now and then fly across the daytime sky.
starlit.options.keys.tooltip: Set keys to toggle Starlit or open this screen.
starlit.options.reset.tooltip: Puts every Starlit setting back to its default.
